payload.comment: Several risks and ambiguities have been identified across the experiment design, preprocessing, and training stages, particularly related to class interpretation and dataset variability. These issues should be carefully managed to ensure the robustness and reliability of the model. The dataset and profiling results are consistent but also indicate some risks. The preprocessing plan includes appropriate augmentations and normalization, but the class imbalance and variability need to be carefully addressed.
llm_issues: Mix of tissue types and cancer stages may lead to interpretation variability
Class imbalance could affect model performance
Potential for misclassification exists, especially for less common classes
Need for expert validation to ensure accurate class labels
Limited test domain, with test images from a different clinical center
Dataset shift between training and test sets could impact model generalization
